The novel takes place in 3,640 BBY - right after the events of the #SWTOR class stories.}} {{C|In response to: "@DrewKarpyshyn Can You give us any hint about how old Theron is in Annihilation?"}}''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |series=[[Star Wars: The Old Republic (novel series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' novel series]] |preceded by="[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" |followed by=''[[Surface Details]]'' }} '''''The Old Republic: Annihilation''''' is a novel by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] which was released on [[November 13]], [[2012]]. The novel is the fourth entry in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic (novel series)|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'']] novel series. News of the book was released at the [[Del Rey]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' books panel at the [[2011]] New York Comic-Con.{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/posts/10150371905943713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2011-10-16|quote=Just announced at our Del Rey Star Wars books panel: Drew Karpyshyn will write a fourth novel that will tie into The Old Republic for Fall 2012 and Tim Zahn will write a new novel starring Han Solo set in the classic films era. More details to come on both as they develop.}} It takes place just after the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' class stories and focuses on [[Theron Shan]].{{WebCite|url=http://drewkarpyshyn.com/c/?p=394|text=May 15|author=Karpyshyn, Drew|date=2012-05-16|archivedate=20200508071341}} The paperback edition was released on [[October 29]], [[2013]],{{WebCite|url=http://www.chapters.indigo.ca/books/Annihilation-Star-Wars-Old-Republic-Drew-Karpyshyn/9780345529428-item.html|text=Annihilation: Star Wars Legends (the Old Republic)|archivedate=20200805192630}} while the UK paperback was released on [[May 24]], [[2013]].{{TitanBooks|url=6790-star-wars-the-old-republic-annihilation|text=Star Wars: The Old Republic - Annihilation}}
